			always = yes
		}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 0 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 1 }

				mod1440_h_draw = yes
			}
		}

		}
